say:1:1421608001:1.text: Mina, are you alright? I'm so glad you're safe!
say:1:1421608001:1.source_cn: 米娜，你没事吧！幸好我们来得及时！

say:2:1421608002:1.text: I could never be able to sleep at night if something happened to you because of me...
say:2:1421608002:1.source_cn: 要是你为了帮我出了事，我真不知道该怎么面对你……

say:3:1421608003:1.text: Ewan, please don't say that. You've risked your life to help me countless times yourself.
say:3:1421608003:1.source_cn: 埃文，别这么说，你已经不顾自己的安危帮了我很多次了。

say:4:1421608004:1.text: You look so pale! What you need is rest.
say:4:1421608004:1.source_cn: 你脸色看起来很不好！你需要休息！

say:5:1421608005:1.text: But I haven't found any etching irises yet... Without the roots, your master will punish you!
say:5:1421608005:1.source_cn: 可是花我还没有采到……没有蚀芯花，你的主人会惩罚你的！

say:6:1421608006:1.text: If I knew how dangerous it was out here, I would never have agreed to let you do this...
say:6:1421608006:1.source_cn: 如果早知道这里这么危险，我不会让你为我冒这个险……

choice_prompt:7:1421608006.text: If I knew how dangerous it was out here, I would never have agreed to let you do this...
choice_prompt:7:1421608006.source_cn: 如果早知道这里这么危险，我不会让你为我冒这个险……

say:8:1421608007:1.text: It has purple petals with a brown center...
say:8:1421608007:1.source_cn: 花瓣是紫色，花蕊是奇异的棕色……
say:8:1421608007:1.male: It has purple petals with a brown center...
say:8:1421608007:1.female: It has purple petals with a brown center...

choice_prompt:9:1421608007.text: It has purple petals with a brown center...
choice_prompt:9:1421608007.source_cn: 花瓣是紫色，花蕊是奇异的棕色……只需要<style=stress>蚀芯花的根茎</style>就好，谢谢您！您救了我的命，现在又这么热心……
choice_prompt:9:1421608007.male: It has purple petals with a brown center...
choice_prompt:9:1421608007.female: It has purple petals with a brown center...

say:10:1421608008:1.text: I'm so grateful! After saving my life, you're doing this for us too...
say:10:1421608008:1.source_cn: 谢谢您！您救了我的命，现在又这么热心……
say:10:1421608008:1.male: I'm so grateful! After saving my life, you're doing this for us too...
say:10:1421608008:1.female: I'm so grateful! After saving my life, you're doing this for us too...
